title: Trump $TRUMP Memecoin Raises $100M+ from Anonymous Foreign Wallets
description_short: Trump $TRUMP Memecoin Raises $100M+ from Anonymous Foreign Wallets
description_medium: Days before his second inauguration, Donald Trump launched the $TRUMP memecoin, whose initial trading was reported at more than $100 million. Some purchases reportedly came from anonymous wallets, but their owners’ nationalities are not established. A presidentially branded token with undisclosed buyers raises transparency questions about who could direct money toward Trump-affiliated entities.

title: Terminates TPS for Honduras
description_short: DHS announced the termination of Temporary Protected Status for Honduras, starting a wind-down period.
description_medium: In May 2018, the Department of Homeland Security announced that it would terminate Temporary Protected Status for Honduras, beginning a wind-down period for Honduran beneficiaries. TPS had allowed eligible Hondurans already in the United States to remain and work temporarily because of conditions in their home country. The linked announcement could not be read to confirm the termination date or later legal status.
